findings.claim: Concurrent hold requests race between the select and the insert; without a unique constraint two tenants can hold the same unit.
findings.evidence: The "one active hold" check happens before the insert
findings.recommendation: Partial unique index on unit_id for active holds.

findings.claim: The webhook is not idempotent: a retried event inserts a duplicate payments row and captures again.
checkout.session.completed does not include an expanded payment_intent by default, so reading pi.charges.data[0] for last4 will fail.
Stripe Checkout is the wrong product here; an embedded Payment Element would keep tenants on-site.
